headline: 2017 executive order calls for a plan to reorganize federal agencies in the executive branch.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order calls for a broad plan to reorganize the departments and agencies that make up the federal executive branch. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, deadlines, and offices involved cannot be confirmed here. A plan is a proposal, and any actual changes would come later through other actions.

who_it_affects.group: Federal executive branch departments and agencies
who_it_affects.how: They are the subject of the reorganization plan the order calls for.
Their agencies could be affected by changes that come out of the plan, though the order itself sets out a plan, not specific changes.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 13, 2017; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
